questions.text: A vertical ellipse centered at the origin passes through \((3,4)\) and has eccentricity \(\frac45\). Find its equation.

Among all hyperbolas centered at the origin with asymptotes \(y=\pm x\), one passes through \((5,3)\) and another through \((13,12)\). Without graphing, decide which hyperbola is closer to its center at the vertices, and by how much.

questions.text: For what real value of $k$ does the graph of the equation $x^2 + 4y^2 - 10x + 24y + k = 0$ degenerate into a single point?
